title: Holographic trading card loop
creator: learnwithcheer
prompt: Please use Python (OpenCV, NumPy, Pillow) to create a 3D floating looping GIF with the look and feel of a “Pokémon SAR / UR-grade holographic flash card,” based directly on the original image I uploaded (do not redraw the original with an image-generation model; you must preserve 100% of the original image’s details).  Please write and run the code according to the following rendering pipeline and visual standards, then output the GIF file:  1. 【Canvas and 3D Physical Modeling】 - Preserve the original image’s aspect ratio and automatically apply rounded corners (with antialiasing), generating a ring of metallic beveled highlights around the card’s outer edge that reflect light as the angle changes. - Build a 3D perspective rotation animation: use sine/cosine functions to generate 48 seamlessly looping frames (about 22fps). The card smoothly performs a 3D orbital tilt in space (Y-axis ±17.5°, X-axis ±10.5°, slight Z-axis wobble) accompanied by a gentle up-and-down float. - Physical thickness: stack 8 thickness slices with a brushed-metal texture along the Z-axis on the back of the card, so the solid card-edge thickness is clearly visible as it rotates. - Studio lighting: automatically match a dark gradient vignette background to the original image’s dominant colors, a breathing ambient glow behind the card that moves with it, and a Gaussian-blurred floating shadow that shifts in the opposite direction as the tilt angle changes.  2. 【Pokémon-Grade Zoned Holographic Shaders (Light Changes Dynamically with Angle)】 - Zoned masks: automatically separate “dark background areas,” “borders and bright gold-foil areas,” and the “main character illustration area” based on the original image’s brightness and edges. - Micro-etched grating underlay: automatically match a fine underlay to the image’s theme (such as radial light rays / silk ripples / Pokémon Cosmos star speckles) and overlay diagonal micro-gratings. - Dynamic iridescence and sweep light: overlay dual-layer rainbow diffraction light on the dark areas that drifts in real time with the 3D tilt; overlay diagonal specular glass highlight bands and a moving spotlight across the whole image; overlay intense metallic gold-foil reflections on the borders and bright areas. - SAR line-art micro-relief: use Sobel edge gradients to simulate subtle ink relief, so the original image’s line edges produce delicate dimensional highlights that follow the light direction.  3. 【Dynamic Star Flashes and Spatial Particles】 - Anchor several 4-pointed cross star flashes at highlights and focal points in the image, triggering a peak flash when the sweep-light band passes over them. - Add seamlessly looping micro-glow floating particles to the card’s “background layer” and “foreground layer,” with colors that echo the original image.  4. 【Export Specs】 - Export at a width of about 460px (height adapts proportionally), ensuring the animation loops seamlessly from end to start. - Use a 256-color adaptive palette (Median Cut) with Floyd-Steinberg dithering to compress the GIF, keeping rainbow gradients smooth without banding or breaks.  【Optional Customization (if left blank, you will decide automatically based on the original image)】 - Holographic underlay style: [Auto-match / Radial sun rays / Water-ripple silk / Cosmos star speckles] - Metallic card edge and gold-foil tones: [Auto-match / Gilded gold / Icy silver / Iridescent purple-gold] - Exclusive highlight effects: [Auto-match, e.g. add a pulsing star flash or flowing light at a light source in the image]

title: Bright beat-synced Gemini 4 Neon ad
creator: cfenghub
prompt:
用 Three.js + GLSL 写一个单页 HTML，实时渲染一支 15 秒的商业广告动效大片，宣传「Gemini 4 Neon」。整体风格：明亮、干净、高级的科技发布会广告质感，高调光（high-key）、浅色或明亮渐变背景、柔和的蓝/紫/粉/暖白渐变色（参考 Gemini 的四角星与渐变气质）、磨砂玻璃、柔光、焦外虚化、细腻阴影、流体渐变、精致的 3D 几何体与粒子。绝对不要霓虹灯管、赛博朋克、暗黑、故障 Glitch 风格。画面通透有呼吸感，但节奏强烈。不依赖任何外部资源，音效用 WebAudio 程序化合成（明快的电子鼓点 + 轻盈的合成器）。

节奏：120 BPM，每拍 0.5 秒，全片 10 个严格卡点，每个卡点必须同时发生「音效重拍 + 镜头切换/冲击 + 文字出现 + 形态变化」，用干净利落的缩放、推拉、擦除、弹性动画来体现冲击，而不是闪烁和故障。

时间轴（可优化，但卡点数量和节奏不得减少）：
1. 0.0s 纯白/浅色画面，一击鼓点，一颗彩色渐变光点绽放成四角星，文字「Gemini 4 Neon」轻盈浮现
2. 1.5s 镜头猛推穿过星形，色彩涌入，文字「更快 FASTER」，弹性入场
3. 3.0s 转场为流动的渐变丝带，文字「更聪明 SMARTER」，逐字依次弹出
4. 4.5s 渐变丝带折叠成 3D 几何体，镜头环绕，文字「更敢想 BOLDER」
5. 6.0s 三连快切（每 0.25s 一帧），每帧一块磨砂玻璃卡片：「看 SEE」「听 HEAR」「说 SPEAK」，分别带有对应的抽象图形动画
6. 7.5s 镜头拉远，无数玻璃卡片与色块排列成宏大的立体空间，文字「无限 NO LIMITS」，镜头缓冲式冲刺
7. 9.0s 空间折叠重组为整齐的网格，文字「不止于答案 BEYOND ANSWERS」，网格波浪式翻转
8. 10.5s 全屏色彩爆开成彩色粒子与光斑，文字「想象即现实 IMAGINE → RENDER」
9. 12.0s 粒子向中心优雅汇聚，凝成晶莹的玻璃质感 3D 标志，倒数「3 · 2 · 1」
10. 13.0s 「Gemini 4 Neon」标志定格，柔光扫过，14.0s 起出现标语「点亮下一个想法 / LIGHT UP WHAT'S NEXT」，15.0s 柔和淡出

要求：
- 文字全部为程序化生成的动效字（逐字弹入、遮罩擦除、弹性缩放、渐变填充、挤压拉伸），不同卡点使用不同的入场方式，字体现代、大气、留白充足
- 镜头运动丰富：推拉、环绕、穿越、拉远，运镜顺滑、转场利落
- 控制面板：播放/暂停/重播、时间轴拖动、BPM、色彩主题切换（经典渐变/暖白金/冷蓝）、光照与景深强度、文案可编辑、静音开关、画质档位
- 追求苹果、谷歌发布会级别的广告质感，卡点精准，视觉冲击力强，整体明亮高级
